Two caveats worth noting. First, `Store.GetUser` delegates to `Store.ListUsers` and consults `s.userCache`, so if the change touches the `FindUser` argument you should also review `store/user.go`'s `ListUsers` and the three driver implementations (`store/db/{sqlite,postgres,mysql}/user.go`). Second, the many `GetUser` hits in `server/router/api/v1/test/user_email_visibility_test.go` and `user_resource_name_test.go` that call `ts.Service.GetUser(...)` are the API-level RPC (`APIV1Service.GetUser`), not the store method, so they're unaffected unless the RPC signature changes too.
